verdict.rationale: USCIS offers online accounts and a developer platform with a Case Status API and a FOIA API, so event-driven automation is a fair question for this kind of service. However, nothing in the evidence shows user-definable rules, triggers, or automatic actions on events. The status API only supports pulling status on request, which at most lets a developer build polling-based automation themselves; it is not a first-party rules capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
